title: Owner runs bring-up steps 1–4 on the Pi (buses, bindings, reads, switches)
goal: Every probe reads a plausible value and every relay switches
acceptance: Steps 1–4 of the hardware bring-up pass on the Pi, or each failure is reported
Owner go-ahead for every run on the real rig (AGENTS.md, Hardware); the agent never switches hardware itself.
privacy: Neutral, invented test data only; no Tailscale names, IPs, agent tokens or personal data in Git.
escalation: A material scope or effort increase goes to the owner

effort.basis: Estimated 2026-11-24: about 2 h of the owner's time at the rig, wiring faults not included.
